hero.lead: Lingrove connects your code, your translators and your reviewers in one workflow. New strings are translated, reviewed and merged before release day, not three sprints after it.

logosLabel: Trusted by localization and product teams at

problem.title: Localization shouldn't be the last thing standing between you and launch.
problem.lead: Spreadsheets, file exports and email threads made sense when you shipped twice a year. Continuous delivery needs continuous localization.

features.title: Lives in your repository
features.body: Lingrove watches your branches, picks up new and changed strings, and opens a pull request when translations are ready.

features.title: Memory that compounds
features.body: Every approved segment feeds a shared translation memory, so the second release costs less than the first.

features.title: Review in context
features.body: Translators see each string inside a screenshot of the real interface, with length limits and placeholders checked as they type.

features.title: One glossary, enforced
features.body: Product terms, brand names and forbidden words are applied across every locale, vendor and machine engine.

features.title: Machine first, human final
features.body: Route low-risk content through tuned machine translation and send only what matters to professional linguists.

features.title: Release-ready reporting
features.body: Know which locales will be complete by Friday, which are blocked, and exactly what each one is costing you.

workflow.title: From commit to every market in four steps.

steps.title: Sync
steps.body: Connect GitHub or GitLab. New keys are detected on every push to the branches you choose.

steps.title: Translate
steps.body: Memory and machine translation fill what they can. The rest is routed to your linguists or vendors.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Reviewers approve in context. Automated checks catch broken placeholders, length overflows and glossary misses.

steps.title: Merge
steps.body: Lingrove opens a pull request with every approved locale. Your CI runs, your team merges.
